about_the_game:
This DLC contains the Dimension "Fangs & Masks". In it, you will have 5 musical themes, 5 ambient sounds and 10 stingers, all in the aesthetic of the Vampire genre. All that in the palm of your hand. The Dimension details are as follows: 

D0003: Fangs & Masks

Be part of the underground nightlife of the big capital and discover what really goes on behind the curtains

Paid Dimension (DLC)

- Genre: Vampire: The Masquerade

- Tracks:

  • City Streets (theme for city scenery)

  • Investigation (theme for investigative moments)

  • Combat (theme for combat situations)

  • Nightclubs (theme for nightclubs scenery)

  • Haven (theme for safe house or area scenery)

- Composer: Dan Bariani

Este projeto é realizado com recursos da Lei Paulo Gustavo do Governo Federal operacionalizado pelo Governo de Goiás, por meio da Secretaria de Estado da Cultura.
